title: Nipponese Warned To Remain North Of Soochow Creek

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI EVENING POST & MERCURY.

DEC 29 1938

Nipponese Warned
To Remain North
Of Soochow Creek

Japanese living in Hongkew, as
well as visitors from Japan, should
shun areas south of Soochow
Creek lest they fall victims to
Chinese highway robbers, the
Shanghai Mainichi said in a
featured article today.
Japanese plain clothes detectives
of the Shanghai Municipal Police
have been stationed at the
southern end of Garden Bridge
and along Nanking Road to pre-
vent depredations against Japan-
ese by Chinese highwaymen.
These precautionary measures,
were being taken following the at-
tacks on two Japanese by Chinese
of the loafer type on Christmas
night. The Japanese were badly
beaten and robbed of their money.
Similar cases of robbery have
since been reported, the Japanese
daily added.

《上海晚邮报与水星报》。

1938年12月29日

警告日本人
勿越苏州河以南

据《上海每日新闻》今日一篇特刊文章称，居住在虹口的日本人以及来自日本的访客，应避免前往苏州河以南地区，以免成为中国路劫匪的受害者。
上海公共租界工部局警务处的日本便衣侦探已驻守在外白渡桥南端及南京路沿线，以防止中国路匪对日本人实施掠夺。
采取这些预防措施是因为在圣诞夜发生了两起中国人（游手好闲之徒）袭击日本人的事件。这两名日本人遭到毒打，钱财被抢。
该日文日报补充说，此后又有类似的抢劫案报告。

Remarks
(Any outstanding or peculiar feature to be
commented on by investigating officer).

At 8-10pm. on 7/11/38 J.D.C. 221 Yoshinaga,
attached to Central Station, brought to Sinsa
Station the complainant named Mr. S. Naka, a
photographer, and Mr. T. Nakawa, photographer,
both residing at No.412 Changchun Road, off North
Szechuen Road, and through his interpretation, the
following particulars of this offence were obtained:-

The above have recently arrived in Shanghai,
and are therefore not familiar with Shanghai streets.
With the intention of purchasing musical instruments,
they were informed by a friend of a shop selling
such instruments located on Nanking Road opposite
the Wing On Company, and at about 6pm. on 7/11/38
both arrived at the Garden Bridge and were at once
approached by a number of ricksha coolies who were
waiting near the Bridge.

They speak no Chinese, and not wishing to be
separated, both sat in one ricksha and told the
coolie to proceed along the Bund. On arriving at
Peking Road they evidently mistook this for Nanking
Road and directed the coolie to pull them West on
that road. From visits to the scene of the crime
by detectives it was ascertained that the coolie
pulled the ricksha beyond Peking Road to Avenue
Road, and then turned South on Changsha Road, which
is narrow at this point, then crossed Kuling Road
and stopped a few yards over Kuling Road on Changsha
Road. At this spot Changsha Road ends in a cul-de-sac.

The complainants report that five or six male
Chinese of the coolie class then surrounded the

1938年11月7日晚上8:10，中央警局附属的日捕221号吉永（Yoshinaga，音译）将名为 S. Naka 先生的投诉人（摄影师）和 T. Nakawa 先生（摄影师）带至 Sinza（音译）警局，两人均居住在四川北路长春路412号，并通过他的翻译，获得了以下关于此罪行的详情：-

上述人员最近抵达上海，因此不熟悉上海的街道。
本着购买乐器的意图，他们从朋友处得知南京路永安公司对面有一家出售此类乐器的商店，1938年11月7日下午6点左右，两人到达外白渡桥，立即被几名在桥附近等待的人力车夫围住。

他们不会说中文，且不愿分开，两人同坐一辆人力车，吩咐车夫沿外滩行驶。到达北京路时，他们显然误将此路当作南京路，并指示车夫沿该路向西拉行。经侦探实地勘查，查明车夫将人力车拉过北京路至爱文义路（Avenue Road），然后向南转入此时狭窄的长沙路，接着穿过巨鹿路（Kuling Road），在长沙路上越过巨鹿路几码处停下。在该地点，长沙路是一条死胡同。

车辆，将他们从车上拉下来，并开始搜身。投诉人进行反抗，投诉人的夹克和裤子被撕破，口袋里的$1.00现金被抢走。他们挣脱并逃离罪犯，在此期间投诉人掉落了眼镜，无法停下来捡回。随后两名投诉人沿巨鹿路（Nuling Road，原文拼写可能有误，应为Kuling Road）向东跑至虞洽卿路（Yu Yah Ching Road），然后跑到南京路。之后他们成功回到外白渡桥，并与在那裡执勤的日本巡警（J.P.C.）交谈，后者指引他们前往中央警局，在那里他们接受了日捕221号的问询。

随后，日捕221号用车带他们重走了一遍经过的路线，确定犯罪现场位于 Sinza（音译）区后，将他们带至本局。

投诉人表示无法再次认出罪犯，但称他们记下了人力车的号码，即5871号。

调查显示，这辆人力车归 Peu Ping Kung (        ) 所有，住址为法租界爱德华七世大道大悦坊23号。

华捕19号和签署人访问了该地址，得知5871号人力车已于1938年11月7日下午1:30出租给一名名为 Tsang Hyi 的车夫

Seu( □□□□ ), native of Hompo, Badge Number at
present unknown. This man arrived from Hompo about six
months ago and the owner of the Hong states that he
has not previously been in any trouble.

The ricsha should be returned to the Hong by
12-30am. on 8/11/38, but the owner states that if the
coolie is out when curfew commences he sleeps in the
street and may return the ricsha in the morning or
hand same to another puller. He resides in the Hong and
will in any case return to the Hong at about 1pm. on
8/11/38. A detective has been left on the premises to
effect his arrest should he return.

C.D.S. 19 and the undersigned also visited the
Garden Bridge and examined the numbers of all public
ricshas waiting there, but without result.

The nearest policeman to the scene at about 6pm.
on 7/11/38 would be C.P.C. 2687 on duty at Park and
Kuling Roads, about 150 yrds from the scene. He was
not aware of the offence.

C.D.S. 19 and the undersigned also made extensive
enquiries in the vicinity of Changsha and Kuling
Roads, there being several shops there, but no witnesses
could be found, and it is quite possible that the
complainants have mistaken the street in which the
crime took place.

Seu（□□□□），虹口籍，目前警号不详。此人约于六个月前从虹口来沪，该人力车行（Hong）老板称其此前未曾惹过麻烦。

人力车应于1938年11月8日凌晨12时30分归还至该车行，但车主表示，若宵禁开始时车夫在外，他便睡在街上，可能于次日早晨归还人力车，或将其交给另一名车夫。他居住在该车行，无论如何将于1938年11月8日下午1点左右返回车行。已留一名侦探在该处守候，以便在其返回时实施逮捕。

刑事侦缉股19号探员（C.D.S. 19）及本人亦前往外白渡桥，检查了停候在那里的所有公共人力车的编号，但未有结果。

1938年11月7日下午6点左右，距离案发地点最近的警察是中央捕房警员2687号（C.P.C. 2687），当时正在派克路（Park Road）和古岭路（Kuling Road）执勤，距现场约150码。他对这起罪行并不知情。

刑事侦缉股19号探员及本人也在长沙路和古岭路附近进行了广泛查询，那里有几家店铺，但未能找到证人，很有可能是报案人记错了案发街道。
